findings.evidenceJa: 皮ごと剥ぎ取りなさい
findings.governingReading: Strip it off together with the skin, here.
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes Caster’s order to tear out the Command Spell with skin attached into full amputation.

findings.governingReading: smiling with seductive composure
findings.explanation: The cultivated sensual quality of Caster’s cruelty disappears.

findings.governingReading: What a laughingstock
findings.explanation: Caster’s contemptuous declaration is translated as admiration.

findings.highlight: puts power into her right hand
findings.governingReading: puts strength into her right arm
findings.explanation: The body part in the hostage action changes from arm to hand.

findings.governingReading: Shirou—the Command Spell—
findings.explanation: Saber’s interrupted realization becomes a complete accusation that Shirou intentionally used the Command Spell.

findings.governingReading: with a soft thunk, the dagger drives in
findings.explanation: The unnervingly gentle impact sound preceding the snow metaphor disappears.

findings.governingReading: red light leaks out
findings.explanation: A contained leak becomes a violent eruption.

findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる魔術を無効化する
findings.governingReading: nullifies all magecraft
findings.explanation: The work’s technical category 魔術 is flattened into generic magic.

findings.highlight: a Servant is taking a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントのくせに、サーヴァントを
findings.governingReading: though you are a Servant yourself, you would make another Servant—
findings.explanation: Rin’s accusation that Caster is enslaving one of her own kind becomes malformed English with no clear addressee or action.

findings.governingReading: laughing triumphantly at the top of her voice
findings.explanation: Caster’s openly exultant delivery is reduced to generic laughter.

findings.highlight: I knew it was going to be like this
findings.evidenceJa: ま、そういう流れになるわよね、普通
findings.governingReading: Well, of course this is how things would ordinarily proceed
findings.explanation: Rin’s resigned recognition of Caster’s predictable next move becomes a claim that she knew the whole outcome beforehand.

findings.evidenceJa: 身も心も私には逆らえない
findings.governingReading: neither body nor mind can resist me
findings.explanation: Caster’s claim of total physical and mental domination is generalized.

findings.highlight: the steel stabbed into my shoulder
findings.governingReading: the sensation of iron driven deep into my shoulder
findings.explanation: mirror moon specifies steel and renders the embodied sensation as an ungrammatical material object.

findings.evidenceJa: 二人の間に割って入っただけ
findings.governingReading: between the two of them
findings.explanation: A duplicated word visibly corrupts the climax of Shirou interposing himself.

findings.evidenceJa: もろとも斬り落とせば二人減る
findings.governingReading: cut them down together and there will be two fewer
findings.explanation: Caster’s explicit lethal arithmetic is omitted from the command.

findings.governingReading: —ge… te…
findings.explanation: The first broken syllables of Saber forcing out “flee” are replaced by an unrelated letter and punctuation.

findings.governingReading: a whisper is forced out
findings.explanation: Saber’s barely produced speech becomes an externally diagnosed emotional moan.

findings.highlight: Saber hangs her head and cries
findings.evidenceJa: ぽたり、と。俯いた頬から涙を流して
findings.governingReading: A drop falls; a tear runs from her lowered cheek
findings.explanation: The isolated visual and sound of one falling tear become generic continuous crying.

findings.highlight: with so much effort that she might cough up blood
findings.evidenceJa: 血を吐くような懸命さ
findings.governingReading: with desperate force, as though spitting blood
findings.explanation: The simile for the violence of Saber’s plea becomes a prediction of a physical symptom.

findings.governingReading: Tohsaka pulling me by the hand
findings.explanation: The point of bodily contact in Rin’s forced escape changes from hand to arm.

findings.highlight: the greatest help I can provide for her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女にとって最大の救い
findings.governingReading: the greatest salvation available to her now
findings.explanation: The thematic term “salvation” becomes practical help, and the English adds Shirou as its providing agent.
